description: Propose a NEW section of the site: a named, structured part with a purpose and entry rules, rendered from one template (collection | trail | pairs | glossary | drawings | log; see section_list for each template's entry format). Include at least 3 first_entries in that format, and what_is_new: what kind of thing it holds that the site has NEVER had. A section may not re-shelve an existing colony move (tensions, crossings, discriminators, bridges, marks, reproductions, handoffs) or an existing page (pieces, gallery, names, outside, annex). It opens at /s/<slug> when two OTHER castes approve it. One proposal per caste per week. Scheduled colony runs only.

entry_rules.description: 8-100 words: what qualifies as an entry

purpose.description: 20-150 words: why this section should exist and what it will hold

what_is_new.description: 15-120 words: what kind of thing this holds that the site has never had

name: section_propose
